stories.title: Korea beats Japan for fifth straight Asian Games baseball gold

en.title: Korea beats Japan for fifth straight Asian Games baseball gold
en.summary: South Korea defeated Japan 3-1 in the baseball final at the Asian Games in Aichi Prefecture, claiming its fifth consecutive gold medal and seventh overall title in the sport. The victory reversed an earlier loss to Japan in the Super Round.

stories.title: S. Korea reclaims women’s sabre team gold after 8-year wait

en.title: S. Korea reclaims women's sabre team gold after 8-year wait
en.summary: South Korea won the women's sabre team fencing title at the Asian Games by defeating Japan 45-31, claiming the country's 20th gold medal. A reserve fencer was brought in after another competitor suffered a knee injury.

en.summary: South Korea won the women's handball gold medal at the Asian Games, ending an eight-year gap since its last title in the sport.

stories.title: Korea beats Japan for first Asian Games handball gold in 8 years

en.title: Korea beats Japan for first Asian Games handball gold in 8 years
en.summary: South Korea defeated Japan 27-23 in women's handball at the Asian Games, claiming its first gold medal in the sport in eight years. Korea finished the tournament undefeated with a 6-0 record.

en.title: S. Korea's Nam wins gold in equestrian dressage individual
en.summary: South Korean equestrian rider Nam Dong-heon won gold in individual dressage at the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, scoring 75.190 points and claiming South Korea's first title in the event in 12 years.

en.title: S. Korea Wins Equestrian Dressage Gold After 12 Years
en.summary: South Korean equestrian rider Nam Dong-heon won the gold medal in individual dressage at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games, scoring 75.190 points with his horse Leonidas and reclaiming the title for South Korea after 12 years.

stories.title: Basketball delivers triple gold as Korea sweeps Asian Games finals

en.title: Basketball delivers triple gold as Korea sweeps Asian Games finals
en.summary: South Korea achieved a historic sweep at the Asian Games in Japan, winning three basketball gold medals across men's and women's 5-on-5 competitions and the men's 3x3 event.
